name: abap2ui5
description: Develop abap2UI5 apps in VS Code: F9 launches a z2ui5_if_app class in an embedded preview, reload on activation, static view checks, the abap2UI5 MCP server for AI agents, snippets.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The view check and the MCP server can be told which program to start. Those settings are read from your user settings only, so a repository cannot point them at something else - but the render gate and the MCP server do start processes, which is why this is limited rather than unconditional.

abap2ui5.launchUrlTemplate.markdownDescription:
URL template used to launch an abap2UI5 app. The `{class}` placeholder is replaced with the (upper-cased) class name.

Example: `https://host:44300/sap/bc/z2ui5?app_start={class}&sap-client=100`

For more than one system use `#abap2ui5.systems#` instead - this setting is the single-system shorthand and stays the first entry of the list.

name.description: Shown in the picker and the status bar, e.g. DEV or Sandbox.

url.description: Launch URL template with the {class} placeholder.

abap2ui5.systems.markdownDescription:
The systems F9 can launch against. The active one is picked with the command **"abap2UI5: Select System"** and is remembered per window, so two windows can work against two systems at once. Credentials are stored per host, so switching does not ask again.

```json
[
  { "name": "DEV", "url": "https://dev:44300/sap/bc/z2ui5?app_start={class}&sap-client=100" },
  { "name": "Sandbox", "url": "https://box:44300/sap/bc/z2ui5?app_start={class}" }
]
```

abap2ui5.allowUnauthorizedCerts.markdownDescription:
Allow the embedded preview's local auth proxy to talk to systems whose **TLS certificate cannot be verified** - self-signed certificates, private CAs not in the OS trust store, hostname mismatches. SAP development systems typically serve self-signed certificates, which is why this is on by default.

**Security tradeoff:** while this is enabled, the connection to the system is encrypted but not authenticated - a machine-in-the-middle could present its own certificate and read the traffic, including the SAP credentials the proxy injects. If your system has a properly trusted certificate, turn this off to get full TLS verification.

abap2ui5.codeLens.markdownDescription: Show *Run*, *Activate & reload*, *Check views* and *Autofix n findings* above the class definition of an abap2UI5 app. The autofix lens appears only while the view check has findings it can correct mechanically.

enumDescriptions: Embedded in an editor tab, through the local auth proxy (with login).
Embedded in the bottom panel, through the local auth proxy (with login).
Open in the default browser (reuses your existing SAP session/SSO).
abap2ui5.openMode.markdownDescription:
How F9 opens the app.

- `tab`: embedded in an editor tab. Runs through a **local auth proxy** that injects your SAP credentials (asked for once) - no 401.
- `panel`: the same, but in the bottom panel area - the **abap2UI5 Control View** tab next to Terminal and Output.
- `external`: in the normal browser (reuses your existing login, no proxy needed).

The commands **"abap2UI5: Show the Preview in the Panel"** and **"abap2UI5: Show the Preview in an Editor Tab"** switch this setting and take a running app along, so the choice does not have to be made up front.

To reset the credentials, run the command **"abap2UI5: Clear Stored SAP Credentials"**.

enumDescriptions: Reload when the shown class is activated - with Ctrl+F3, or detected on the server when activated any other way (a save only marks the preview as "not activated").
Reload every time the shown class is saved - for setups in which saving already publishes the change.
Never reload on its own - use the reload button, the status bar or F9.
abap2ui5.reloadOn.markdownDescription:
When the preview of the shown app class reloads by itself.

- `activation`: on **Ctrl+F3** (*abap2UI5: Activate and Reload Preview*), which activates the class through your ABAP tooling and then reloads. An activation done any other way - the ABAP extension's own button, or Eclipse - is picked up too: while the preview is marked *not activated*, the class is watched on the server (through its ADT services) and the preview reloads as soon as it is active again. The **abap2UI5** output channel shows what the watch sees. Saving alone leaves the server on the active version, so it only marks the preview as *not activated*.
- `save`: on every save of the shown class.
- `never`: only on F9, the reload button or the status bar.

abap2ui5.reloadOnSave.markdownDescription: Reload the preview when the shown app class is saved.
abap2ui5.reloadOnSave.markdownDeprecationMessage: Replaced by `#abap2ui5.reloadOn#`. Saving does not change anything on the server - activation does. Still honoured while `abap2ui5.reloadOn` is unset: `false` behaves like `never`, `true` like `save`.

abap2ui5.viewCheck.onSave.markdownDescription:
Run the static view check every time a checkable file is saved: an ABAP class building views with `z2ui5_cl_ui5_view_builder`, or a raw `*.view.xml` / `*.fragment.xml`. Findings appear in the Problems panel. The command *"abap2UI5: Check Views (Static)"* runs the same check on demand.

To also apply every mechanical fix on save, opt in via VS Code's own setting:

```json
"editor.codeActionsOnSave": { "source.fixAll.abap2ui5": "explicit" }
```

abap2ui5.viewCheck.live.markdownDescription: Also check while typing, shortly after each pause. Only the bundled property gate runs on a keystroke - it works in-process and needs no I/O; the render gate stays on save and on demand.

abap2ui5.viewCheck.command.markdownDescription:
Command that runs the [abap2UI5-linter](https://github.com/abap2UI5/linter) CLI **for the render gate** - the property gate is bundled with the extension and needs no command. Leave empty for the default: a local checkout under `#abap2ui5.mcp.reposRoot#` when present (runs with VS Code's own Node.js), otherwise `npx --yes github:abap2UI5/linter`.

Example for a local clone: `node /home/me/linter/cli.mjs`

This setting names a program the extension starts, so it is read from your user settings only - a cloned repository cannot point it somewhere else.

enumDescriptions: SAPUI5 - the distribution served by an ABAP system. Includes sap.ui.comp (Smart controls), sap.suite.*, sap.ushell, sap.fe and more.
OpenUI5 - the open-source distribution. Controls from SAPUI5-only libraries are reported: they do not exist there.
abap2ui5.viewCheck.distribution.markdownDescription:
Which UI5 distribution the target system serves. SAPUI5 ships libraries OpenUI5 does not (`sap.ui.comp`, `sap.suite.*`, `sap.ushell`, `sap.fe`, `sap.viz`, ...), so a SmartTable is fine on SAPUI5 and a guaranteed runtime error on OpenUI5. With `openui5` such controls are reported as errors.

A workspace's `abap2ui5lint.jsonc` wins over this setting - that is the file CI checks against.

abap2ui5.viewCheck.minUi5.patternErrorMessage: Must be a UI5 version like 1.71 or 1.120.3. A value that is not a version is silently ignored by the check, which then runs against the default floor.
abap2ui5.viewCheck.minUi5.markdownDescription:
The UI5 version to check against - **the version your system runs**. A control or property introduced after it is reported (it would not exist on your system), and a deprecation is only reported once it is in effect at that version. The metadata itself comes from the bundled snapshot; see the abap2UI5 output channel for the version it was generated from.

A workspace's `abap2ui5lint.jsonc` wins over this setting - that is the file CI checks against.

abap2ui5.viewCheck.render.markdownDescription: Also run the render gate: the reconstructed view is loaded with a real `XMLView.create` in headless Chromium. Unlike the bundled property gate this needs the external checker - install it once with *"abap2UI5: Install Render Gate"* (downloads the checker bundle and Chromium, runs with VS Code's own runtime), or provide your own via `#abap2ui5.viewCheck.command#` / `#abap2ui5.mcp.reposRoot#`.

abap2ui5.viewCheck.allow.markdownDescription:
Accepted deviations for the property gate, e.g. `sap.m.GenericTile.systemInfo` - each entry is passed to the checker as `--allow`. Merges with the `allow` list of a workspace's `abap2ui5lint.jsonc`.

To waive a single line rather than a whole rule, put the linter's own directive above it: `" abap2ui5lint-disable-next-line unknown-binding-path -- filled in a LOOP`. The quick fix on any finding writes it for you, and CI honours it too.

abap2ui5.viewPreview.theme.markdownDescription: The UI5 theme *"abap2UI5: Preview View (No System)"* renders in. Any theme name the runtime ships, e.g. `sap_horizon`, `sap_horizon_dark`, `sap_fiori_3`, `sap_belize`.

abap2ui5.viewPreview.viewport.markdownDescription: The viewport the systemless preview renders at, `<width>x<height>` in CSS pixels - e.g. `390x844` to see the view the way a phone lays it out. The picture is taken full-page, so a view taller than the viewport is shown whole.

abap2ui5.mcp.enabled.markdownDescription: Offer the [abap2UI5 MCP server](https://github.com/abap2UI5/ai-mcp) to MCP clients in this window (Copilot agent mode and others). The server gives AI agents the abap2UI5 dev loop without an SAP system: capability queries, static view validation, deploy, build, headless run with screenshot.

abap2ui5.mcp.system.markdownDescription: Also offer the **abap2UI5 System** MCP server: real-system tools hosted by the extension itself - list the configured systems, search classes on the system (ADT quick search) and run an app through the auth proxy with a headless screenshot. Uses the same credentials the preview stores; the run tool needs the render gate's Chromium.

abap2ui5.mcp.command.markdownDescription:
Command that starts the MCP server. Leave empty for the default: a local checkout under `#abap2ui5.mcp.reposRoot#` when present, otherwise `npx --yes github:abap2UI5/ai-mcp`.

Example for a local clone: `node /home/me/ai-mcp/server.mjs`

This setting names a program the extension starts, so it is read from your user settings only - a cloned repository cannot point it somewhere else.

abap2ui5.mcp.reposRoot.markdownDescription:
Folder containing the checkouts the MCP server orchestrates (`abap2UI5`, `samples-controls`, `samples`, `samples-stack`, and optionally `linter`, `ai-mcp`). The matching `A2UI5_HOME` / `SAMPLES_CONTROLS_HOME` / `SAMPLES_HOME` / `SAMPLES_STACK_HOME` / `AI_VIEW_CHECK_HOME` environment variables are passed to the server, and local `ai-mcp` / `linter` checkouts found here are preferred over downloading via npx.

What is found here decides which programs are started, so it is read from your user settings only.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with abap2UI5
walkthroughs.description: Launch an app with F9, keep the preview fresh on activation, and let the view check catch problems while you type.

steps.title: Point the extension at your system
steps.description:
Set the launch URL of your abap2UI5 endpoint - `{class}` is the placeholder for the app class.
[Set Launch URL](command:abap2ui5.setLaunchUrl)

steps.title: Run an app with F9
steps.description: With the cursor in a class implementing `z2ui5_if_app`, press F9 - the app opens next to the source.

steps.title: Activate and reload with Ctrl+F3
steps.description: Only activation changes what the server runs - Ctrl+F3 activates through your ABAP tooling and reloads the preview.

steps.title: Let the view check catch problems
steps.description:
Typos, too-new controls and dead bindings land in the Problems panel while you type.
[Check Current File](command:abap2ui5.checkViews)

steps.title: Read the view as XML
steps.description:
See the XML the builder calls produce, live beside the class - findings mirrored, every line clickable.
[Show Reconstructed XML](command:abap2ui5.showReconstructedXml)

steps.title: Give your AI agent the dev loop
steps.description: The bundled MCP server lets Copilot agent mode and friends build and run abap2UI5 apps without an SAP system.
